insights_description: Sabrena Jo, PhD, is a Senior Director of Science & Research at the American Council on Exercise (ACE Fitness) and an Exercise and Health Scientist. Sabrena also serves as a Health Advisory Board Member at U.S. News & World Report and Forbes. Previously, Sabrena worked as a Faculty Lecturer at The University of Kansas, where Sabrena taught undergraduate students about personal and community health. With a Master of Science in Physical Education/Biomechanics, a Bachelor of Science in Kinesiology and Exercise Science, and a PhD in Health and Physical Education/Fitness, Sabrena is dedicated to translating the science of health, wellness, and physical activity to promote movement among individuals.

insights_description: Donna Pscolka has held several positions in the loan servicing and financial services industry since the late 1980s. Currently, Donna serves as the Senior Manager of Loan Servicing at Dime Community Bank. Prior to this role, Donna was the Assistant Vice President of Multi Family Commercial Real Estate at Astoria Federal Savings. Throughout their career, Donna has gained experience in various aspects of loan servicing, from commercial to residential collections and foreclosures. Donna's educational background includes an Associate of Applied Science in Business from Nassau Community College and a Bachelor of Business Administration in Business Administration and Management.

insights_description: Akim Smiley is a seasoned professional in data engineering and technology consulting with extensive experience in the energy sector. Currently serving as the Lead Data Engineer at Devon Energy since July 2013, Akim has previously held roles such as Senior Applications Developer/Analyst at Chesapeake Energy and Technical Lead at Vitech Systems Group. Additional experience includes positions as a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting and Senior Technology Consultant at BearingPoint, as well as a Database Analyst at the District Attorney's Council. Akim Smiley holds a Bachelor of Business Administration in Management Information Systems from the University of Central Oklahoma, earned between 1995 and 1999.

insights_description: Satya Nadella is the Chairman and CEO of Microsoft, a role held since February 2014. In addition to this leadership position, Satya serves as a member of the Board of Trustees at the University of Chicago since 2018 and has been a board member at Starbucks from 2017 to 2024. Satya held the position of Chairman at The Business Council U.S. from 2021 to 2023 and served as a board member for Fred Hutch from 2016 to 2022. Educational qualifications include a Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering from Manipal Institute of Technology, a Master's Degree in Computer Science from the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee, and an MBA from The University of Chicago Booth School of Business, where studies were completed from 1994 to 1996.

insights_description: Benjamin Solomon Carson Sr. (born September 18, 1951) is an American retired neurosurgeon, academic, author, and government official who served as the 17th United States Secretary of Housing and Urban Development from 2017 to 2021. A pioneer in the field of neurosurgery, he was a candidate in the 2016 Republican presidential primaries. Carson is one of the most prominent black conservatives in the United States.
